blocks.caption: The wings of the Light Fury

blocks.text: White, swift, and gone in a flash. Where her dark cousin hides in the night, the Light Fury hides in plain daylight.
10 out of 10 in every stat, and 12 in Speed, beyond the cap. No collection bonus, a long dragon tail, and a gift of their own.

Once the Light Wings are in your collection, a new button appears in the Wings menu: Equip appearance. Select any pair you own and wear its look over the pair you fly with: model, colours, tail and even the rhythm of its beats.

Only the look changes. Stats, physics and the Furies' powers stay those of the pair you actually wear. On the pair worn as appearance, the button reads Reset appearance. Your choice is kept when you switch pairs, and other players see it.
Dive beyond your top speed and the Light Fury's shriek rings out.

In travel flight only, wearing the Light Wings, hold the brake for 2 seconds: blue-white plasma gathers at your mouth. Then press sprint within half a second: a plasma blast bursts about 30 blocks ahead, and you fly through it and vanish, invisible for 15 seconds. The dash has a 5-second cooldown.
Joined at the Assembly Table from the Fury Saddle, the Light Fury Core and two Light Fury Wings, for 250 of each essence. Or, with the luck of the dragons, from a mythic summon at the Draconic Altar.
